1. In packages/runtime/src/ship/close.ts, add optional `risk?: "low" | "medium" | "high"` and `prompt_tokens?: number` fields to TaskHistoryRow. Do not touch USAGE_AT or usageTotals, so the token and cost totals stay as they are.

2. In close.ts, add an exported `promptTokens(task: Task): number | undefined`. It reads only build-beat timeline entries whose text starts with `build started` (both the full-path and the fast-path lines). It collects every `~(\d+(?:,\d+)*) prompt tokens` match, allowing for an optional k suffix in case #189 writes `~12k`, and returns the largest figure, or undefined when no line has one.

3. In closeTask, set `risk: task.card.risk` on the row (the card schema defaults it to medium). Add `prompt_tokens` only when promptTokens returns a number, using a conditional spread so the key is left out of the JSON otherwise. The written-row dedupe check stays unchanged.

4. Add packages/runtime/src/ship/history-cost.test.ts, reusing the repo, task and close fixture approach from ship.test.ts (a proved task closed with --abandon, then the .rivetari/history.jsonl row read back). Cover A1: a low-risk card whose ledger has build-started lines with ~1200 and ~4800 prompt tokens gives `risk: low` and `prompt_tokens: 4800`, and a task with no such line has no prompt_tokens key. Also add pure promptTokens cases that check agent text on build-done lines is ignored.

5. In packages/cli/src/commands/metrics.ts, add an exported `costFlags(rows: TaskHistoryRow[])` that keeps rows with `risk === "low"` and `cost_usd > 1`. Rows with no risk are never kept (A3). Add an exported `renderCost(rows)` that prints a `Cost` header, then one line per flagged row with the task id, `$cost_usd.toFixed(2)` and prompt_tokens (or n/a), or `  none: no low-risk task cost over $1` when nothing is flagged. Get the rows from `historyRows(root)`, which @arynbht/rivetari-runtime already exports; import the TaskHistoryRow type from there too.

6. Wire the cost section into runMetrics. Append renderCost to both text outputs (the --findings path, which needs no GitHub, and the full DORA path), and add a `cost` key to both JSON outputs. Leave the existing sections and their order alone so metrics.test.ts keeps passing unchanged.

7. Add packages/cli/src/commands/metrics-cost.test.ts, following the tmp dir and stdout spy pattern from metrics.test.ts, using runMetrics(dir, { findings: true }, { token: null }). Cover A2: a low-risk row at cost_usd 1.40 with prompt_tokens is listed with id, cost and prompt tokens, while a low-risk row at 0.80 and a medium-risk row at 3.00 are not, and a history with no flagged rows prints the none line. Cover A3: a row with cost_usd 5 and no risk field is not listed. Add unit cases for costFlags and renderCost directly.

8. Add .changeset/history-cost.md with minor bumps for @arynbht/rivetari-runtime and @arynbht/rivetari. Run `pnpm action:build` and commit the rebuilt packages/action/dist. Run `pnpm vitest related --run` on close.ts, metrics.ts and the two new test files after the build, then `pnpm run lint` and `pnpm run typecheck`. Check the diff has no new comments and no edits to existing tests.
